description.value: Anecdote is a cozy neighborhood café on West Broadway in Vancouver, serving specialty espresso drinks alongside freshly baked pastries made in-house. The space is designed as a community gathering spot — equally suited to solo work, catching up with friends, or lingering over a matcha latte. The menu leans into plant-friendly options, with vegan and vegetarian items prominently featured.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (8 spaces) at 46m; stands (2 spaces) at 49m; stands at 60m; stands (2 spaces) at 62m. Total: 12 spaces.
